job.description: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Semiconductor Technology Development Intern Innovation, Technology & Products (ITP) Albany Nanotech | Albany, New York Summer 2027 About Micron Micron is a global leader in memory and storage solutions that transform how the world uses information to enrich life. The Innovation, Technology & Products (ITP) organization is responsible for developing the next generation of memory technologies and enabling future Micron products. At Albany Nanotech, Micron is establishing a leading-edge research and development presence focused on advanced lithography, materials innovation, technology pathfinding, and strategic semiconductor ecosystem partnerships. Albany serves as a key location for accelerating technology development and expanding collaboration across leading research institutions, equipment suppliers, and industry partners. Position Summary Micron is seeking highly motivated Master's and PhD students to join our Summer 2027 Semiconductor Technology Development Internship Program in Albany, New York. As an intern, you will work alongside engineers and researchers developing future semiconductor technologies, advanced process capabilities, and next-generation memory solutions. You will contribute to meaningful technical projects, gain hands-on experience in semiconductor research and development, and present your work to engineering leadership at the conclusion of your internship. This role is ideal for students who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, working with advanced technologies, and contributing to innovations that will shape the future of the semiconductor industry. Internship Areas Interns may support projects in one or more of the following areas: Advanced Lithography & High-NA EUV Materials Research & Innovation Process Integration Thin Films & Deposition Dry Etch Technology Metrology & Defect Analysis Advanced Packaging Technologies Automation & Data Analytics Semiconductor Equipment Development Technology Pathfinding & Research Albany's initial focus includes advancing next-generation lithography, enabling High-NA EUV, accelerating materials innovation, and driving technology pathfinding in collaboration with leading industry and research partners. Responsibilities Support semiconductor research and development activities Design and execute engineering experiments Analyze technical data and identify trends Apply statistical methods to solve engineering problems Develop recommendations based on experimental results Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams and external research partners Document findings and communicate technical results Participate in team meetings, technical reviews, and development activities Deliver a final project presentation to technical leadership Leverage AI-enabled tools, data analytics platforms, and digital solutions to enhance research productivity, accelerate problem-solving, improve data analysis, and support technical decision-making while adhering to Micron's standards for responsible and secure AI use. Minimum Qualifications Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD degree in: Chemical Engineering Materials Science & Engineering Electrical Engineering Mechanical Engineering Physics Chemistry Computer Engineering Data Science Related STEM discipline Additional qualifications: Expected graduation date of December 2027 or later Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Effective written and verbal communication skills Ability to work independently and within collaborative teams Demonstrated interest in advanced technology research and development Preferred Qualifications Semiconductor manufacturing, research, or laboratory experience Cleanroom experience Experience with data analysis tools such as JMP, Python, R, MATLAB, or similar software Knowledge of statistical methods and experimental design Experience conducting independent research projects Technical publications, conference presentations, or research experience preferred Experience using AI-assisted tools, advanced analytics platforms, or computational methods to improve engineering, research, data analysis, or problem-solving workflows. What You'll Gain Hands-on experience in semiconductor research and development Exposure to leading-edge semiconductor technologies Mentorship from experienced Micron engineers, researchers, and technical leaders Opportunities to collaborate across multiple engineering disciplines Professional development and networking opportunities Experience working within one of the industry's most advanced semiconductor research ecosystems The opportunity to contribute to technologies that will enable the future of memory innovation Why Albany? Albany Nanotech is one of the world's premier semiconductor research environments, bringing together industry leaders, universities, equipment suppliers, and research organizations to solve some of the industry's most complex technology challenges. Micron's Albany team is focused on advancing next-generation lithography capabilities, accelerating materials innovation, enabling future technology roadmaps, and strengthening strategic research partnerships that support the future of memory technology development.
